# Farzad Roozbahani

> SEO Specialist & Developer

In recent years, I have developed an interest in the world of digital marketing, especially in the field of SEO. I started studying and learning about SEO from various sources, and gradually launched my first successful SEO project. Having previously worked in graphic design and motion, I also have a good understanding of the tools and techniques in this field. Additionally, I have spent some time learning and utilizing programming languages like Python and PHP.

The site is served in two languages at separate URLs: English under /en/, Persian (فارسی) under /fa/. The root URL (/) redirects visitors to their browser-preferred language.

## Skills

SEO & Marketing: Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Google Trends, Technical SEO, On-page SEO, Screaming Frog, Moz, Wincher, Keyword Research, Schema.
Development: WordPress, HTML, CSS, Git, Ubuntu.
Design & Motion: Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere, Corel, Figma, Maya.
Programming: Python, Arduino C++.

## Latest posts (English)

- [Keyword Research Beyond Search Volume: A Practical Framework](https://feris.ir/en/blog/keyword-research-practical-framework/): Search volume tells you how many people type something into Google. It doesn't tell you whether ranking for it will earn you a single customer.
- [How to Speed Up a WordPress Site Without Breaking It](https://feris.ir/en/blog/speed-up-wordpress-without-breaking-it/): The fastest way to make a WordPress site faster is also the fastest way to break it. Here's the order that actually works.
- [5 Technical SEO Issues That Quietly Kill WordPress Rankings](https://feris.ir/en/blog/technical-seo-issues-wordpress/): WordPress makes it easy to publish and just as easy to accumulate crawl and indexing problems nobody notices until traffic drops.

## آخرین پست‌ها (فارسی)

- [تحقیق کلمات کلیدی فراتر از حجم جست‌وجو: یه چارچوب عملی](https://feris.ir/fa/blog/keyword-research-practical-framework/): حجم جست‌وجو فقط می‌گه چندنفر یه چیزی رو تو گوگل تایپ می‌کنن. نمی‌گه رتبه‌گرفتن براش حتی یه مشتری برات میاره یا نه.
- [چطور سایت وردپرسی رو سریع کنیم بدون اینکه چیزی خراب بشه](https://feris.ir/fa/blog/speed-up-wordpress-without-breaking-it/): سریع‌ترین راه برای سریع‌کردن وردپرس، همون سریع‌ترین راه برای خراب‌کردنشه. این ترتیبیه که واقعاً جواب می‌ده.
- [۵ مشکل سئوی فنی که بی‌سروصدا رتبه‌ی سایت وردپرسی رو نابود می‌کنن](https://feris.ir/fa/blog/technical-seo-issues-wordpress/): وردپرس نوشتن مطلب رو راحت می‌کنه، ولی همون‌قدر هم راحت می‌ذاره مشکلات ایندکس و خزش بدون اینکه کسی متوجه بشه جمع بشن.
